rationale: Create one canonical Network FiberCo, LLC parent platform. The joint venture closed on August 1, 2025 with PSP Investments holding 51% through PSPIB Quadratic Blocker, LLC and BCE/Ziply holding 49% through Northwest Fiber, LLC. Network FiberCo's subsidiaries own and build wholesale fiber while Ziply is the exclusive operator and retail ISP; Ziply remains a separate company and NFC Management and NFC Northwest remain rolled into this parent boundary. No later equity transfer or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through September 1, 2026.

afterImage.description: Network FiberCo, LLC is a U.S. wholesale-fiber joint venture formed by PSP Investments and BCE in August 2025. Through NFC Management and NFC Northwest, the platform owns and develops fiber infrastructure initially focused on Washington, Oregon, Idaho and Montana and intended to expand into additional underserved U.S. markets. Ziply Fiber is the exclusive network operator and retail internet service provider. PSP Investments holds 51% through PSPIB Quadratic Blocker, LLC and BCE/Ziply holds 49% through Northwest Fiber, LLC. Network FiberCo is counted separately from BCE-owned Ziply because it has a distinct cap table and wholesale asset base; its wholly owned subsidiaries are not counted separately. No later equity transfer or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through September 1, 2026.
